Subject: Draft: Marketplace product page + CTAs (need guidance on billing matrix)

Team / AWS support —

Attaching a draft of the product page copy and the usage matrix we plan to publish. Two asks up front:

1) AWS support: does the usage-matrix.csv map cleanly to the Private Offer metering/AMIs flow? We want to ensure the SKU names and billing footnotes match what AWS will surface for billing and for private offers. If there are required fields or a preferred column order, please call them out.

2) Internal: copy feedback — we need the CTA localized for US/EMEA (shorter button text for mobile). Also want to keep the hero focused on latency/cost-per-token callouts (per our positioning).

Attachments: marketplace-copy-v2.docx (draft product page), usage-matrix.csv, pricing-footnotes.pdf

Notes in the draft:
- Hero line uses: "Predictable LLM inference for production" (we can tweak)
- Primary CTA: "Start free" vs localized variant "Get started" — which reads better for AWS Marketplace?
- We added a small billing footnote referencing per-token vs per-request pricing — want legal/AWS guidance if that needs extra wording.

Next steps: Laura — can you do a copy pass with short mobile CTAs? Kimberly — can you check entitlements mapping in the matrix and validate SKU names? Marissa — can you confirm partner/co-sell opt-in checkbox language? AWS support — any immediate redlines?

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Head of Partner GTM (acting)
Redwood Inference

Thanks Alex — quick pass below (inline). I also attached an annotated copy with suggested hero tweaks.

Inline notes (high level):
- Hero: shorten to "Predictable inference, production scale" (keeps benefit + product).
- Primary CTA: prefer "Get started" for Marketplace listings — shorter and less promotional. Use "Start free" on our hosted site.
- Mobile CTA: shorten to "Get started" and use a single-word action in localized languages (FR: "Commencer", DE: "Loslegen"). We should vet translations with localization team but keep characters minimal.
- Billing footnote: move to a collapsible section under Pricing with the exact column names from the usage matrix (avoid free-text).
- Pricing-footnotes.pdf: note says "pricing examples are illustrative" — change to "pricing examples are representative and subject to final contract terms".

Action items I can take on:
- I'll apply the hero/pass edits and push a new doc by EOD 9 June (marketplace-copy-annotated.docx).
- Marissa: can you confirm the co-sell checkbox language? I want the sentence: "I consent to being contacted by Amazon AWS and Redwood Inference for co-selling opportunities."
- Kimberly: confirm SKU/entitlement names match internal metering.

Laura Bennett
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft: Marketplace product page + CTAs (need guidance on billing matrix)

Hi Alex / team —

Thanks for the draft and the attachments. Quick guidance based on the current Marketplace intake requirements: 

1) Usage matrix (CSV): required columns are: "SKU_ID", "Metering_Unit", "Price_Per_Unit", "Description", "PrivateOffer_Entitlement". If you currently have different column names, please provide a mapping file.

2) Billing footnote: the Marketplace will display only a short footnote — any extended legal language should be hosted on a public pricing doc referenced by a URL. The exact phrasing we surface is limited for UX consistency. That means your "pricing-footnotes.pdf" should be distilled into a one-line footnote (we recommend: "Per-unit pricing; actual charges depend on usage and private offer terms.").

3) CTA recommendations: "Get started" is commonly used and tests well on listing pages. For localization, provide the CTA text per locale in a CSV (locale, cta_text). Mobile truncation will be handled but shorter strings are preferred.

4) Co-sell opt-in: include an explicit checkbox on the private offer form. The Marketplace legal team requires the opt-in text to mention "contact by AWS and Redwood" and a link to your privacy policy.

References: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/listing-requirements.html

If you send the updated CSV with the required columns and the localized CTA CSV, we can validate it in the seller console and flag any AMI/entitlement mismatches.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Support
aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
